newsitem.title: UK: North Sea July crude liftings seen up 190,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: North Sea July crude liftings seen up 190,000 bpd.

text.p: July loading schedules for the eight main British and Norwegian oilfield systems project liftings will rise by about 190,000 barrels per day (bpd) from June, programmes released this week by operating companies show.

Daily liftings in July from Norway's Ekofisk, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Statfjord and Troll and Britain's Brent, Flotta and Forties systems are scheduled at 4.49 million bpd, up from a revised 4.30 million bpd in June, the programmes show.
July programmes project 231 cargoes versus 209 in the shorter month of June.
The heavier loading schedules are mainly the result of the completion of maintenance programmes, particularly at the Forties and Oseberg systems.
